pairs.subject: conversation-orchestration
pairs.evidence: app/_components/chat/ChatTranscript.tsx:163 The shared transcript's in-flight face is a fixed 'thinking' label plus one static hint after 8s, and the component has no lane for live narration beats, so a companion turn running for minutes shows nothing about what it is doing. The companion that mounts this transcript has no beat grammar anywhere either: no 'beat'/'narrat' hits in app/_lib/companion*, app/features/shell/companion or pipeline/jobfit/companion*.

techniques.evidence: app/_components/chat/ChatMiniChart.tsx:108 The chart scales over an intact viewBox and stops shrinking at a floor where its 14px labels stay readable; past that floor its own scroller takes over. Related evidence in the same context: ChatBlocks.tsx:29 renders blocks full-bleed under the bubble, ChatTable.tsx:47 draws a placeholder for a missing cell (never blank, never zero), chatChartAlt.ts:23 builds an sr-only text alternative from the block's own values, and series colours are token presentation attributes (ChatMiniChart.tsx:44). The caps are one authority in chatBlockTypes.ts, imported by the validator.

app/_components/chat/ChatTranscript.tsx:163 The busy state renders only a static label. Nothing lifts or renders model-authored progress lines, and no beat vocabulary exists in the companion producer, so long turns go silent.
